endpoint_note: The subscription (coding-plan) endpoint. The general /api/paas/v4 endpoint is documented as NOT interchangeable: a request sent there does not draw on the coding-plan subscription at all and spends pay-as-you-go balance instead, which on a plan-only account is $0 and surfaces as error 1113.

recorded_endpoints.note: The general platform endpoint. Recorded so the self-check has the wrong-endpoint case by name; never wired.
Documented for Claude Code and Goose. Sinet's zai lane rides opencode as OpenAI-compatible, so this variant is a recorded dated fact and no second path is built.

credential.note: A broker engine-cred auth-profile NAME. The worker record holds this reference; the material is resolved fresh at spawn and never stored, logged, or persisted.

model_routing_note: Requests for previous models (GLM-5.2 / GLM-5.1) are automatically routed to GLM-5.3 by the plan itself (verified 2026-08-23). These seed ids are DATA with a date, never the authority: the account's own observed model list is.

reasoning_effort.note: Real and newly verified on the general chat-completion reference (default max; GLM-5.3 accepts only low/high/max; effective only while thinking is enabled). No page confirms the CODING endpoint honors it and no named spec section sanctions it, so it is recorded as a dated fact and deliberately not wired.
